evidence.quote: The Bachelor of Computer Science Engineering focuses on design and technology within a 7-semester undergraduate training.
Tuition Fee for the program: 3.400 USD/semester
Register on the online application site of the University of Pécs

notes: Tuition: the pages give only USD figures (US$3,400 per semester on the programme page and on the PTE apply page); no EUR or HUF self-financed fee for a non-EU/EEA student is stated. Application fee of US$150 is also stated but is not a tuition fee. The apply.pte.hu page shows an application deadline of 15 Jun 2027 for the 2027/28 intake, while the English programme page mentions 30 May 2027 for Computer Science Engineering BSc; the apply.pte.hu dates are used in 'intakes'.

note.fr: Un entretien en ligne est requis : l'oral et l'écrit au niveau B2 minimum. Consultez https://english.mik.pte.hu/selection-process
note.en: An online interview is required: minimum B2 level in oral and written. See https://english.mik.pte.hu/selection-process

evidence.quote: Entrance examination: Yes Entrance type: Oral
